data.title: Terra Golf Collection
data.about:
Discover Terra Golf Collection by Taraf, an esteemed residential community nestled in the highly sought-after Jumeirah Golf Estates. This elite neighborhood offers 6-bedroom standalone and twin villas, as well as 6-bedroom townhouses with spacious living spaces and captivating views of lush landscapes. 

Residents can luxuriate in private amenities like a gym, home cinema, private pool, and jacuzzi. Terra's villas and townhouses provide breathtaking, uninterrupted vistas of the lush golf course, all while embracing a design that's minimalist yet exudes elegance. The use of neutral color palettes and fundamental materials accentuates the inherent natural beauty, further enriched by luxurious finishes.

Terra, developed by Taraf, the real estate arm of YAS Holding, a prominent UAE-based investment holding company with a diverse business portfolio spanning various sectors and over 50 subsidiary companies. With 84 exquisite villas seamlessly integrated into the verdant landscapes of a prestigious golf course, Terra embodies contemporary design, functionality, and exclusivity. The architectural concept harmoniously blends modernist minimalism, sleek geometric lines, and the natural beauty of the golf course surroundings.

characteristics_module.title: The most sought-after villas in Jumeirah Golf Estates
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• An unparalled lifestyle amongst a golf course
  • Modernist minimalism in design, blending sleek lines with natural beauty
  • 84 villas celebrate simplicity and a deep connection with the landscape
  • Spanning from 4,600 sq ft to 8000 sq ft
  •  Indulge in State of the art amenities
  • Villas: Lush golf course views, elegant design, spacious interiors, cinema, gym, and more
  • Stand Alone Villas: Bespoke living with private theater, bar, and gym
  • Twin Villas: Facing the golf course, luxurious rooms, and greens view
  • Townhouses: Stylish design, spacious rooms, and green backyard access

location_tile.title: In the heart of Jumeirah Golf Estates
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover Terra Golf Collection in the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates, an affluent residential and leisure development situated in the southwest of Dubai, UAE. This opulent community is celebrated for its world-class golf offerings and upscale living, making it a sought-after destination for golf enthusiasts and those in pursuit of a luxury lifestyle.

Areas Nearby:

  • 35 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 35 Minutes to DWC Airport
  • 40 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 40 Minutes to DXB Airport
